d: Short, wavy olive-brown hair with messy bangs frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, olive-green eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white collared shirt under a dark teal and gold asymmetrical jacket, paired with dark navy shorts, white tights, and dark brown leather boots. A dark teal beret with a white feather plume sits atop the head, complemented by accessories including gold tassels, a small brown leather pouch at the waist, and a white quill pen held in one hand and a small book in the other.
